StringWithMarkup.String: Dibenzo-18-crown-6 is a crown ether that is 18-crown-6 ortho-fused to two benzene rings at positions 8-9 and 17-18. It has a role as a phase-transfer catalyst. It is a member of benzenes and a crown ether.
